detail.longDescription:
are you a fan of #teamtalk ? do you also happen to have #ttcom / #TTCom #teamtalk #commander , or its more modern equivalent, #powercom , made by @seedy60@vee.seedy.cc ? have you wished you could access TTCom in your browser, and/or over the network?
well now you can!
introducing webcom, a odkcer container used to access ttCom over the network, receive notifications, etc.
for this project, I used docker, which means you can host it in a #docker environment.

available to test here: https://github.com/averlice/webcom
